title: I'm working on a web3 MMO game inspired by Ultima Online
author: Ok_Mirror_832
selftext:
I've attached some crude screenshots, not a lot of work done on graphics and gameplay yet, but I built a really secure and robust backend/core with a terrain system, sprite pipeline, and resource system where world objects grow and decay.

The web3 side will unlock a real economy and publicly verifiable ownership of items. We are also backing NPCs with LLM and long term memory. 

If anyone is interested in teaming up or sharing ideas I'd be down. I currently have 1-2 friends that are helping with further development and testing.
